fields.title: Background Color
fields.description:
(*optional) 

   Foreground vs Background Color   

   

 Disclaimer: If you would like your Twill Patch to be a 1 Color Layer only, please select the NONE option below for the background color. 

   

 Otherwise, if you choose the same background color as the foreground color, they will blend together and become hard to read.

fields.title: Use Single Color Crest (Optional)
fields.description:
IMPORTANT: Use this option if your organization offers both multi-color and single colored crests. 

 Please upload the corresponding crest artwork below - note that if the single color crest option is selected but a multi-color crest is uploaded instead, we will be defaulting to the multi-colored crest. 
 
Only certain organizations have a single color variation in addition to their default multi-colored crest! Please ensure the appropriate artwork is available and uploaded!

fields.title: Crest Customization (Single Color Crests ONLY)
fields.description:
IMPORTANT: Please note that for crests that use a single color, you must indicate what embroidery color you would like to use in the text box below. If no embroidery color is indicated, we will be using the default crest color. 
 
If a multi-colored crest is uploaded instead of a single colored crest, we will be defaulting to the multi-colored crest! 
 
Only certain organizations have a single color variation in addition to their default multi-colored crest! Please ensure the appropriate artwork is available and uploaded!
